definitions.data: Complete final MediaFile rows, every source raw graph (one scoped restoration at a time), all observations/coverage/selected values/eligibility/freshness/read states/basis/reasons, every file operation stamp and object receipt, source scheduling, discovery/reconciliation issues, existing callbacks and completion flags. Field order and list order preserved; source pointer identity is covered in archive unit tests. Allocation capacities are not semantic facts.
definitions.hashBuffer: QDataStream Qt_6_0 BigEndian streams through a bounded 64 KiB SHA256 sink; no whole-graph serialization buffer. The probe retains only one restored source at a time.
definitions.memory: Current process physical footprint and peak resident size captured immediately after ScanEngine::scan returns, before hashing/restoring any source. This direct Canon probe excludes UI row adapters and widgets.
definitions.timing: Diagnostic verification only, not a speed benchmark. Final guard repeat may overlap regression-suite CPU load. Earlier diagnostic timings are preserved in comparison-first-pair.json.
definitions.inputs: Existing genuine local Avid media and databases; device/inode/size/mtime_ns checked on 2,425 source paths and six media folders before/after each scan and across the final before/after pair.
